place.source_title: Commercial buildings, Front Street and Butler Street

brief: Corner group of 19th-century three-storey brick and painted-stone commercial buildings: a bracketed Italianate cornice, tall hooded windows, a canted corner entrance and a cast-iron storefront; neighbours of the same height line the block.

floors: W W W W W W
W W W W W W
facade.notes: Front & Butler Streets, Marietta (1875): a row of three-storey Italianate blocks -- a white-painted one on the corner with an ornate bracketed cornice and arched hooded windows, then red brick and buff brick neighbours, all with shopfronts (a market, a block named KETTER BLOCK); brick-paved sidewalk; traffic signal

why.note: a continuous three-storey street wall of varied Italianate fronts
